name: Closed Cases Total
query:
SELECT
    u.full_name AS "Case Owner",
    i.case_owner as "email", 
    COUNT(*) AS "Closed Issue"
FROM
    `tabIssue` i
JOIN
    `tabUser` u ON i.case_owner = u.email
WHERE
    i.status = 'Closed'
GROUP BY
    i.case_owner, u.full_name
ORDER BY
    "Closed Issue Count" DESC;
